Project Description
fields.value: Welcome to Disha Harmony, where life is a seamless blend of nature and nurture. This thoughtfully designed residential haven brings together luxury, comfort, and sustainability across every corner. Nestled in a serene, green landscape, Disha Harmony offers residents an oasis of calm amidst the city’s energy. With 3.25 acres of lush greenery, 3 towering structures, 247 thoughtfully designed units and over 30 world-class amenities, this project is crafted to cater to every age and lifestyle. At Disha Harmony, residents enjoy the benefits of an expansive clubhouse, panoramic views, indoor and outdoor recreational facilities, and dedicated spaces for work, wellness, and relaxation. The spacious and well-designed units are tailored for families, professionals, and retirees alike, offering privacy and comfort in every home. With amenities that cater to a balanced life, including quiet nooks, vibrant play areas, serene garden trails, and relaxation decks, Disha Harmony is designed for those seeking a harmonious living experience. Located in Hennur, it is close to essential services yet surrounded by nature, embodying the essence of community and convenience in a contemporary environment. Disha Harmony—Crafted for a Lifetime of Connection.
